name: lokier-late
description: cart plays his recording into the Apartments, holds back out of Lokier's sight, then peeks the window about 2.5 s late: Lokier's scripted hit lands about 1 s after he sees cart, and cart kills him for real about 2.6 s after the recorded kill. Then he walks his recorded way (the Balcony drop, B site) to Shop and plays his recording again.
